decision.reasoning_trace: The search results for backpacks were heavily skewed toward specialized gear (cooler bags, hydration packs, baseball bags) or accessories (lamp poles, tents). Within the actual backpack category, I narrowed the selection down to a premium trekking pack (Osprey), a brand-name mesh pack (adidas), a specialized cooler pack (TOURIT), a hydration pack (ROCKRAIN), and a popular sling bag (NICGID). The NICGID Sling Bag was selected as the final choice because it offers the best balance of high customer satisfaction (4.5 rating) and social proof (nearly 4,000 reviews) at an accessible price point, making it a reliable purchase for general outdoor and travel use.
